nodes.label: ADR 0015: Package Purchase via Stripe Payment Link
nodes.rationale: Use Stripe Payment Link for package purchases. Flow: create package_instances row (status=pending), create Stripe Price on tenant's Connect acct, create Payment Link with application_fee_amount and metadata (type:package, packageInstanceId, organizationId). payment_intent_data.metadata must mirror Payment Link metadata explicitly for webhook event to carry packageInstanceId. Webhook fast path on payment_intent.succeeded flips package to paid/active. UI surfaces URL with Copy/SMS/WhatsApp share buttons.
alternatives_rejected: Stripe Checkout via redirect (equivalent but more code)
Stripe Elements in-app (card-present only, no remote)
